faq.question: Can I pursue a business management degree in Canada after completing my 12th grade education?
faq.answer: Yes, undergraduate business management courses in Canada are open to students who fulfill the academic and English language requirements.

faq.question: Does an MBA in Canada require work experience?
faq.answer: Professional experience is either required or preferred by many MBA schools, however criteria differ. Candidates with little job experience are accepted into several master's programs in management.

faq.question: How long do business management courses last in Canada?
faq.answer: Usually, undergraduate degrees require three to four years to complete. Depending on the degree, postgraduate programs often last one to two years.

faq.question: How much does it cost to study business management in Canada?
faq.answer: Depending on the curriculum and school, tuition might vary from about CAD 20,000 to CAD 60,000 or more per year.
